newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen rising marginally.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen rising marginally.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected to rise moderately on Monday mostly on buying of selected blue chips, brokers said.
"The rally may continue as we expect buying of some weighted financial and cement scrips," said broker Sabbir Ahmed.
He said some engineering and food scrips might fall on profit taking by small investors.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index gained 42.19 points or 4.39 percent at 1,002.97 on a turnover of 41.6 million taka on Sunday.
